x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item.body: Update set 1: CMDB_IRE_<client>_v1 (global) — reviewed by the Design Authority - Identification rule entries, reconciliation rules, data refresh rules - Deactivation of direct cmdb_ci transform maps Update set 2: CMDB_Sources_<client>_v1 (global + each connector scope) - Discovery schedules/behaviours; SGC configuration; IntegrationHub ETL - Credentials and MID server config are environment-specific — not promoted Update set 3: CMDB_Governance_<client>_v1 (global) - CMDB Health thresholds, Data Manager policies, de-dup templates - Notifications, reports, dashboards Data (not update sets): CSDM business apps/services/offerings, ownership backfill, group records.
